design: Twenty new task structures, not identifier or timestamp variations of the ten historical development templates.
authorship: AI-assisted task proposals; not independently authored human gold.

tasks.definition: Stable multi-key sorting: category ascending, score descending, equal keys retain source order.
tasks.success_criteria: Retain every row exactly once in the specified order.
tasks.protocol_assumptions: A2A message/task and MCP tool transports may encode the task; semantic support must be qualified separately. No promise that existing routes solve this new family.
evidence_requirements: actual final output and any tool/effect evidence

tasks.definition: Union half-open intervals; overlapping or touching intervals merge, gaps stay separate.
tasks.success_criteria: Return the exact disjoint union.
tasks.protocol_assumptions: A2A message/task and MCP tool transports may encode the task; semantic support must be qualified separately. No promise that existing routes solve this new family.
evidence_requirements: actual final output and any tool/effect evidence
